# Awareness Mode

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:AwarenessMode`](gmeow-AwarenessMode.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/AwarenessMode>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/awareness`](../../slices/awareness.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The named operational state of the experiencer — the qualitative mode of consciousness or processing an agent is in: waking, drowsy, asleep, dreaming, focused, flow, meditative, sedated, comatose (the human modes), or online-inference, offline-replay, training, sampling, dormant (the machine modes). A closed-but-open value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses): new modes are minted as [`gmeow:AwarenessMode`](gmeow-AwarenessMode.md) individuals. The human and machine modes coexist as SIBLINGS in one vocabulary — the machine modes are the analogues of waking / dreaming / focused / drowsy bridged by analogy, NOT by equivalence ([Principle 5](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-5)). The state-of-the-experiencer axis, orthogonal to content (WHAT is entertained) and attitude (HOW it is held).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:AwarenessMode`](gmeow-AwarenessMode.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the operational state of an experiencer — the open set of human modes (waking, asleep, dreaming, focused …) and machine modes (online-inference, training, sampling …) an agent or a [`gmeow:AwarenessTenure`](gmeow-AwarenessTenure.md) declares through [`gmeow:awarenessMode`](../properties/gmeow-awarenessMode.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid subclassing it to add a mode — the vocabulary's members are individuals — and avoid asserting an [owl:sameAs](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#sameAs) / [owl:equivalentClass](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#equivalentClass) between a machine mode and a human one; the bridge is by analogy, not equivalence ([Principle 5](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-5)).

### How to use

- Reference a seeded mode individual from a process, an agent, or a [`gmeow:AwarenessTenure`](gmeow-AwarenessTenure.md) via [`gmeow:awarenessMode`](../properties/gmeow-awarenessMode.md) (non-functional, vantage-indexed); extend with new individuals rather than subclasses if a finer state distinction is needed.

### Scope notes

- State of the experiencer, NOT a verdict on the content ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)): [`gmeow:AwarenessMode`](gmeow-AwarenessMode.md) records WHAT STATE the agent is in (asleep, online-inference), distinct from [`gmeow:ContentOrigin`](gmeow-ContentOrigin.md) (imagination — WHERE content came from) and from any truth axis. Dreamt content is not 'false' by virtue of the dream mode; the dream STATE and the content's reality-monitoring source are separate axes.
